details.summary: Create Zero Seed (ZERO): 1000000000000000000000000000 base units (18 decimals), 999999999999999999999999559 installed for sale from 0.00000101733601133519 to 0.0000999465120512176 quote per token; trading opens at Unix 1800000600; creator fee 50.0000% decaying toward 0.3000%. 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266 becomes the owner. No quote deposit; principal is locked forever. details.disclosures lists every risk, including the quote-token trust.

statements.text: Zero initial bid: the pool starts with no native ETH. Until someone buys, selling the launch token fills nothing.
Buyer-funded quote reserve: the only native ETH in the pool is what buyers pay in. Sells can withdraw only that.

Permanent principal lock: of the total supply of 1000000000000000000000000000 raw units, 999999999999999999999999559 go into one position that nobody, including you, can withdraw, rebalance, migrate or refund, and the remainder of 441, too small to pay for one more unit of liquidity, is minted to address(0), where nobody can ever spend it. Quote that buyers pay in is locked in the position too.

Creator fee: 50.0000% at trading start 2027-01-15T08:10:00.000Z. The excess over 0.3000% halves about every 86400.000001 s, so the fee approaches 0.3000%, a long-run floor and not an end date: it reaches 0.3000% exactly only by rounding, or once more than 5529597 s have passed since trading start. The excess over 0.3000% first falls to half or less 86401 s after trading start. The fee is taken on the calculated side of every swap into a separate two-asset fee ledger, never into principal.

Launch ownership: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266 (this account) becomes the launch owner. Only the current owner can claim the fee ledger, and ownership can be transferred. Whoever owns the launch when it claims receives every unclaimed fee, including fees earned before a transfer.

Owner recapture: every fee goes to the launch owner. When the owner, or anyone buying for it, trades, it gets that fee back through its claim: on an exact-input buy at 50.0000% it can end up with the whole pre-fee output, while anyone else making the same trade gets only the net. The fee cannot tell owners, snipers and honest buyers apart.

High early fee: near 50.0000%, a swap can deliver a negligible or zero amount after the fee, and an immediate round trip pays the fee twice plus price impact. A high starting fee is not protection against snipers and does not promise that anyone avoids a loss.

Exact-output gross-up: for a fixed output, the input paid is the pre-fee input times 1 / (1 - fee), about 2.00x at 50.0000%, which grows much faster than the fee itself. Large amounts at high fees revert on overflow. Always set a minimum output or a maximum input.
No exit guarantee: there is no buyer of last resort, no refund and no admin rescue. The price can fall back to the ask.
Quote trust: the quote is native ETH, which Core accounts for itself. No quote token contract is trusted.
